Do not canonicalize by short C# or bare source alias without source artifact identity.

Author code, public forks, and same-paper external-runtime tests are reproducibility support, not independent numerical replication unless a non-author rerun under a provenance-equivalent protocol is actually present.
Plot-read approximate values are retained only as approximate diagnostics and do not earn exact-table evidence credit.
assessments: peer-reviewed ODDL provides exact final-accuracy tables and direct threshold/capacity diagnostics for task-free discrepancy-triggered expansion, but the most decision-relevant over-expansion counts are plot-read approximations and the study reports no standardized false-alarm, delay, ARL, precision or recall metric; treat it as evidence that accuracy can coexist with poorly calibrated structural expansion, not as a calibrated boundary detector

LargeMonitor's public code establishes a genuine same-label heterogeneous ImageNet-HS stream and a frozen-DINO rolling-CKA monitoring path with explicit batch/buffer defaults, but no exact alarm precision/recall, false-positive rate, delay or miss-rate table was verified; strong artifact support for the mechanism/benchmark family does not yet establish detector quality

peer-reviewed Envelope-BO compares against target-only Generic-BO on multiple ML hyperparameter tasks, reports exact time-to-best cells such as 55.65 vs 131.37 s and 4256.43 vs 11855.69 s, and learns source noise so unrelated source observations are effectively ignored; evidence strongly supports a model-scoped safe-transfer fallback but lacks independent replication and should not be generalized beyond its GP/noise assumptions

ALT/PMLR best-arm theory gives a hard impossibility boundary: unrestricted unbounded-support fixed-confidence identification can require infinite expected samples, while a declared moment constraint permits asymptotically optimal robust identification; reported max-min solve costs motivate batching, but this is a source-domain theorem/algorithm result rather than direct evidence for arbitrary agent-evaluation schedulers

peer-reviewed nested-clustering work separates diagnostic FWER from post-selection inference validity and uses 400,000-replication simulations to show same-data cluster-level pre-testing can under-cover at intermediate dependence; this is strong causal/simulation evidence for keeping dependency-unit selection separate from final inference, while transfer to sequential agent evaluation remains untested

peer-reviewed small/heterogeneous-cluster evidence directly compares CV1/CV2/CV3 and WCR variants over 400,000-replication designs; representative G=84 null rejection is 4.97% WCR-S versus 9.04% CV1 and an empirical 70-cluster example has a 47% CV3-vs-CV1 SE gap, strongly supporting effective-cluster/leverage diagnostics and validated small-cluster resampling, not literal transplantation of OLS machinery to bounded agent scores

primary multi-way clustering work establishes that one-way inference can fail severely under crossed dependence and that appropriate bootstrap methods improve finite-sample behavior, but the current wave does not extract the newer 2025 exact table cells and has no agent-specific task×judge/policy simulation; retain as a structural dependence-map guardrail

a 2026 preprint decomposes iterative self-correction into error-introduction and correction rates and reports a matched GPT-4o-mini verify-first intervention reducing EIR 2%→0% and changing -6.2 pp degradation to +0.2 pp with paired p<1e-4; ICLR-2024 correct-to-worse results independently corroborate the failure mode, but the successful intervention is one model/prompt condition on reasoning datasets

three model families on FRAMES/MuSiQue are compared under matched requested reasoning-token budgets and single-agent baselines generally match or beat several MAS variants above the tiny-budget floor; the paper itself shows requested tokens are not guaranteed realized compute for closed APIs, so the evidence rejects uncontrolled-compute MAS advantage in this tested setting rather than establishing exact equal-FLOP superiority

an independent 2026 study finds many automatically generated MAS cost-dominated by strong single-agent controls while an expert-designed MAS positive control improves GPT-OSS 26.1→36.1 and GPT-5 57.0→96.5 at comparable cost; the positive control is especially important because it confines the negative result to automatic orchestration/search, not the MAS family

a matched environment-hardening intervention reduces exploit rate 6.5%→0.8% while task success changes 83.2%→82.8%, with a reported 5.7-pp absolute exploit reduction, 95% CI [4.8,6.6] and p<1e-4; this is strong causal benchmark evidence that structural defenses matter, but adaptive attackers were not re-optimized against the hardened environment and the setting is sandbox-specific

a controlled counterfactual holds actions and observations fixed while rewriting only CoT across roughly 800 web trajectories/659 tasks/9 VLM judges; judge false positives can rise sharply and robustness defenses trade against roughly 10–20 pp true-success recall in several settings, directly demonstrating rationale-sensitive evaluation risk without estimating natural deception prevalence

primary exact tables now show AgentRewind 87.8±1.2 task success versus Continue 62.2±2.1 on one GPT-5.4 MettleBench setting, direct coupled-state ablations, and 30% versus 8% recovery on identical failed endpoints; Terminal-Bench also provides a crucial counterexample where whole restart 70.8 trails Continue 78.7, so evidence supports aligned selective rewind rather than restart-after-failure and does not identify an optimal rewind-target policy

DART directly tests semantic checkpoint admissibility under dependency/effect contracts: an external LangGraph schedule-form case has generic checkpoint-aligned restore success 0.00 versus DART 1.00 with 1 replay action and about 1.11 s, while the five-domain audit reports 0/35 unsafe admissions under frozen specifications; strong within-paper structured-runtime evidence, but reviewed contracts and action-boundary-observable failures limit transfer to open-ended agents

matched tool-RL ablations show trajectory purification improves AIME/GPQA while an explicit local-negative failed approach can later collapse training when the visible tool error is rooted in upstream reasoning; this strongly supports causal-depth-matched repair for training trajectories, not a runtime rollback controller

peer-reviewed Extract-QD uses a fixed total evaluation budget and shows selective elite re-evaluation can preserve exploration better than repeated sampling or whole-archive verification; EME outperforms all compared methods on Ant at p<1e-3 and EPGA beats PGA on three control tasks at p<5e-3 under matched evaluation counts, while the reported 25% verification share remains an unevaluated design choice rather than a universal optimum

NeurIPS-2024 D-PBEMO provides direct evolutionary optimization with stochastic pairwise human preferences, clustered dueling-bandit allocation and an O(K^2 log T) regret result across 48 problems; it supports preserving preference uncertainty/adaptive comparisons but does not provide an injected LLM-judge error sweep or direct systematic-bias tolerance result

a 2026 bioRxiv preprint reports five-seed same-protocol wRNN→DW-RNN gains of +0.55 pp sMNIST, +0.18 pp psMNIST and +1.35 pp noisy sequential CIFAR-10 while retaining the recurrent wave form, but no parameter-count/factorial dendritic control or code release is available; gains cannot yet be uniquely attributed to dendritic computation rather than added input-path expressivity/regularization

LeanSearch v2 provides strong primary quantitative evidence for global proof-route retrieval: MathlibQR Recall@10 0.780, MathlibMPR route coverage 30.4%, and fixed-prover FATE-H 4/100 no retrieval→14/100 standard→20/100 reasoning, with reflection 16/100→20/100 under the same pipeline; official code exists, but global benchmark/downstream sets are small and no independent rerun is established

TheoremGraph releases a 388,105-declaration/11.3M-edge typed Lean dependency graph and graph expansion reaches Recall@10 0.775, within 0.5 pp of LeanSearch-v2 reranked retrieval; the result is concept retrieval rather than end-to-end proof success and lacks a matched latency/solve-rate comparison against iterative proof-state retrieval

VeriSpecGen reports 86.6% SpecGen with Claude Opus 4.5, up to +31.8 points over baselines, 343,827 trajectory examples and fine-tuning gains, while requirement decomposition/traceability localize failures before repair; overall ablation supports the framework but no compute-matched localized-repair-vs-full-rewrite causal ratio is exposed and some concrete-test validation can fall back to an LLM judge

AutoResearchClaw's direct Debate ablation drops selected quality 5.62→4.25 (p=0.003) and its K={2,3,5} sensitivity shows bounded diversity/token trade-offs; independent controlled debate studies support diversity-aware initialization while homogeneous debate shows conformity/cost failure, giving useful boundary corroboration but on reasoning QA rather than open scientific discovery

Arbor's matched MLE-Bench-Lite ablations keep the same tools/workspace/protocol/backbone and report Any Medal 81.82% full versus 63.64% without the hypothesis tree and 54.54% without insight feedback, strongly supporting structured hypothesis/evidence memory plus distilled lesson propagation in this autonomous-research setting; every component is not individually isolated and no independent replication is established

AutoResearchClaw's 10-run half-life sweep qualitatively reports 7-day premature expiry, infinite-life contradiction accumulation and a 30-day local optimum, while an independent general-agent memory study reports about +10 pp from selective add/delete over naive accumulation; the cross-domain corroboration supports selective forgetting as a mechanism class but does not establish a scientific-agent utility/evidence-gated retention rule or universal half-life

SkillProx directly separates write-time closed-loop gating from later counterfactual shrinkage: SpreadsheetBench full 54.5±0.5 versus 53.0±1.0 without closed-loop diagnosis and 52.0±1.0 without Prox, plus a threshold sweep retaining/improving performance under substantial compression and 8/22 hard regressions blocked; strong same-paper causal evidence, but no independent rerun and some deletion gains are case-study/small-panel results

SkillSV uses structure-respecting deletion, length-neutral padding and disjoint panel-B evaluation; pruning AUC improves over Closure-LOO/LLM-judge/random and a one-step refinement retains 69% mean tokens with mean score change -1.3 and no individually significant benchmark change, supporting causal artifact valuation/compression for fixed skills rather than an online self-improvement gain

SePO's direct component ablation gives average 76.38 full versus 74.94 without self-improvement and 72.64 with archive-based open-ended evolution replaced by latest-only linear search, with additional model-pair transfer; evidence supports reachable stepping-stone archives within prompt evolution, but proposal trajectories are not one-for-one compute matched and per-component significance is not reported
updates: Peer-reviewed DEMD exact FID results support unsupervised dynamic memory-distribution expansion/reduction, but its main diagnostics are class/category-incremental and it reports no standardized same-label abrupt-shift alarm delay/FPR. Retain as a memory-distribution candidate, not evidence that the current same-label detector frontier is closed.

Final UAI-2026/PMLR publication resolves venue status only. The released adapter-creation path previously audited still requires unseen ground-truth class information, and exact final tables/ablations were not extracted in this wave; do not upgrade to label-independent same-label boundary creation.

Crab now supplies the previously missing classification audit: 2,063 manually labeled turns, zero false negatives for process/filesystem changes, 100% process accuracy, 98.3% filesystem accuracy and 2.3% filesystem false positives, plus 70–87% checkpoint skipping and 100% recovery under tested crashes. The measured error mode is conservative over-checkpointing, but unobserved kernel/device/network state remains outside the audited label scope.

Normal/gap/variance plug-in allocation must state a tail contract. Heavy-tail best-arm theory shows unrestricted unbounded outcomes can invalidate fixed-confidence sample guarantees; any transfer should fail over to robust moment-constrained machinery rather than silently extending OCBA assumptions.

Safe-transfer evidence is strengthened by a concrete learned source-noise mechanism that continuously downweights mismatched source data and approaches target-only optimization when unrelated; this supports an explicit fallback, not unconditional reuse of historical/proxy evidence.

Exact recovery-depth ablation is now primary-extracted: no recovery 12.1 post-error success, depth≤2 15.5, ≤5 20.7, ≤7 21.5, no cap 22.1, with separate awareness/recovery ablations. This establishes diminishing marginal value of deeper recovery training data, not a runtime rule to roll back five steps.

A non-author 2026 DW-RNN paper reruns the standard wRNN baseline over five seeds and obtains 97.27±0.15 sMNIST, 96.74±0.17 psMNIST and 54.30±0.79 noisy sequential CIFAR-10, close to the original reported values. Count this as partial independent corroboration only: it is not an exact full-suite replication and the official GitHub forks themselves provide no benchmark execution evidence.

The released Memento parametric retriever broadcasts query-level final success onto all query-case rows and performs default validation by shuffled row index, permitting train/validation query overlap and exact-row duplicate overlap. Validation AUC therefore cannot by itself establish held-out-query per-case utility calibration. This finding applies to the released Oct-2025 public training path and does not invalidate the paper's unknown historical protocol or quantify any inflation without a grouped-split rerun.

Argus stage-certificates are durable observability/certification-churn receipts, not the root fail-closed stage-admission lock: transition processing precedes certificate persistence and certificate write failure is tolerated, with backlog fallback downstream. Other review/state-transition guards remain active; do not generalize this correction into 'stage review is unenforced'.

Eureka's current public implementation materially improves inspectability but does not obviously include benchmark generators, raw outputs, seeds or manifests for the reported 50k repeated-search and 30k adversarial-merge suites. Keep large-suite numbers as primary-paper evidence, not independent reproduction.
The same Eureka artifact boundary applies to governed-evolution quantitative policy tables: public control code is not equivalent to an independently reproducible full result suite.

AutoResearchClaw's T10 case shows provenance-bound numeric validity is not sufficient evidence adequacy: 51 logged metric keys can be numerically genuine yet scientifically non-discriminative when all conditions collapse to zero. Preserve provenance gating and a separate discrimination/adequacy check.

Appendix parent-selection experiment narrows attribution: five-run held-out averages rise from random 0.428 to modifiable 0.491 and handcrafted 0.532, but differences are not statistically significant (p>0.05). Editable meta-control can rediscover structured heuristics, yet this does not prove learned parent selection beats a strong fixed selector or isolate persistent-memory/performance-tracking causality.

Primary verification now confirms the KSI transfer matrix/disjoint held-out protocol but the evaluation set is selected from the seed-0 intersection of failures of both recipients; gains support the frozen bundle+task-conditioned-adapter protocol on this hard selected set, not full-distribution effect sizes or single-component isolation. Reproducibility audit is A- for author-side infrastructure but finds no independent numerical rerun.

An independent MetaSkill-Evolve reimplementation instantiates the two-timescale mechanism but its separate small live target-transfer rerun yields +0.12/-0.21/-0.21 meta-gains, mean -0.10±0.16. This is a scoped null for that bare-LLM target-transfer setup, not a failed replication of the paper's OfficeQA/SealQA/ALFWorld benchmark claims.

Official harness-evolution code has strong matched-budget/split traceability but no independent numerical rerun identified. Keep the paper result as primary-study evidence and preserve source-qualified identity; do not cross-attach a different post-reset short C7 audit.

Primary verification finds selective-vs-always-inject ordering depends on aggregation: macro 64.3 vs 63.5 favors selective, while micro 61.2 vs 61.5 favors always-inject. Do not state a universal selective-over-always-inject win without specifying aggregation.
The reported w/o-Subgoal ablation removes subgoal decomposition and context folding together, so it cannot causally isolate folding; retain only the coupled-component result.

Inherited drift, 16/32-step recovery pattern, goal-recognition/action gap and environment dependence are primary-verified; proposed mitigations remain extrapolations beyond the tested intervention set.
